metadata.title: Polynomial conjugacy invariants of pseudo-Anosov maps derived from train track representatives
metadata.abstract: We investigate two kinds of polynomials associated with pseudo-Anosov maps. Each kind consists of three polynomials that are conjugacy invariants of pseudo-Anosov mapping classes and these polynomials contain more information than pseudo-Anosov stretch factors. The first kind is defined by the train track representatives. The second kind is obtained from the first kind by incorporating additional data that encode the transitions among the unpunctured singularities of the invariant foliations. The Birman-Brinkmann-Kawamuro polynomials coincide with those of the second kind. As an application, we prove that the Birman-Brinkmann-Kawamuro polynomials are conjugacy invariants of pseudo-Anosov mapping classes which is also proved by Dodge-Kawamuro, independently.

analysis.workSummary: 构造两类各含三个的多项式不变量，第一类由train track代表定义，第二类加入无穿孔奇点间的转移数据。
analysis.breakthrough: 第二类与Birman–Brinkmann–Kawamuro多项式一致，得到其共轭不变性，作者注明Dodge–Kawamuro独立证明相同应用。
analysis.limitations: 不变量比伸缩因子更细并不表示完整分类共轭，需核对各多项式的正规化。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
